per_question_results.question: How did exchange rates change in Thailand between 2008 and 2012?
per_question_results.sparql:
PREFIX gemr: <https://gemr-kg.org/ontology#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?year ?exchangeRate WHERE {
  ?obs gemr:hasCountry ?country .
  ?country gemr:countryName "Thailand" .
  ?obs gemr:hasIndicator ?indicator .
  FILTER (?indicator IN (gemr:Real_Effective_Exchange_Rate, gemr:Nominal_Effective_Exchange_Rate, gemr:Exchange_rate_old_LCU_per_USD, gemr:Official_exchange_rate_LCU_per_USD, gemr:Exchange_rate_new_LCU_per_USD, gemr:XRATE_OLD_LCU_USD, gemr:REER, gemr:XRATE_NEW_LCU_USD, gemr:NEER, gemr:XRATE_OFFICIAL)) .
  ?obs gemr:hasYear ?yearEntity .
  ?yearEntity gemr:yearValue ?year .
  FILTER (?year >= 2008 && ?year <= 2012) .
  ?obs gemr:observationValue ?exchangeRate .
}
ORDER BY ?year
LIMIT 100
per_question_results.initial_sparql:
PREFIX gemr: <https://gemr-kg.org/ontology#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?year ?indicatorName ?exchangeRate WHERE {
  ?obs gemr:hasCountry ?country .
  ?country gemr:countryName "Thailand" .
  ?obs gemr:hasIndicator ?indicator .
  ?indicator rdfs:label ?indicatorName .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?indicatorName), "exchange rate")) .
  ?obs gemr:hasYear ?yearEntity .
  ?yearEntity gemr:yearValue ?year .
  FILTER (?year >= 2008 && ?year <= 2012) .
  ?obs gemr:observationValue ?exchangeRate .
}
ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX gemr: <https://gemr-kg.org/ontology#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?countryName
WHERE {
  ?country gemr:hasRiskScore ?riskScore2015 .
  ?riskScore2015 gemr:hasYear ?year2015 .
  ?year2015 gemr:yearValue "2015"^^xsd:gYear .
  ?riskScore2015 gemr:governanceScore ?govScore2015 .
  ?riskScore2015 gemr:hasCountry ?country .
  gemr:Historical_private_default_rates gemr:servesAsProxyFor ?privateDefaultRate .
  ?obs2015 gemr:hasCountry ?country .
  ?obs2015 gemr:hasIndicator ?privateDefaultRate .
  ?obs2015 gemr:hasYear ?year2015 .
  ?obs2015 gemr:observationValue ?defaultRate2015 .

  ?country gemr:hasRiskScore ?riskScore2020 .
  ?riskScore2020 gemr:hasYear ?year2020 .
  ?year2020 gemr:yearValue "2020"^^xsd:gYear .
  ?riskScore2020 gemr:governanceScore ?govScore2020 .
  ?riskScore2020 gemr:hasCountry ?country .
  ?obs2020 gemr:hasCountry ?country .
  ?obs2020 gemr:hasIndicator ?privateDefaultRate .
  ?obs2020 gemr:hasYear ?year2020 .
  ?obs2020 gemr:observationValue ?defaultRate2020 .

  ?country gemr:countryName ?countryName .

  FILTER (?govScore2020 > ?govScore2015)
  FILTER (?defaultRate2020 < ?defaultRate2015)
}
ORDER BY ?countryName
LIMIT 100

per_question_results.question: Show me all economic health scores and governance scores for all countries in 2018, ordered by economic health score descending.
